run_encodec_benchmark: run the benchmark script to measure encodec model encoding and decoding performance
build_timer_function: build a timer function using time.perf_counter to measure elapsed time between calls
create_arithmetic_coder: create an ArithmeticCoder instance to perform arithmetic encoding of quantized codes
create_arithmetic_decoder: create an ArithmeticDecoder instance to perform arithmetic decoding of encoded data
build_quantized_cdf: build a stable quantized CDF from probability distributions for arithmetic coding
